Load Records Into Table.description: Inserts an array of records, e.g. form submissions or payments pulled in an earlier step, into an analytics table.

Insert Single Record.description: Inserts one row, e.g. from a webhook payload.

Create Table If Missing.description: Creates the destination table before a first load.

Upsert Rows From Staging Table.description: Merges freshly loaded staging rows into a reporting table without creating duplicates.

Delete Old Rows.description: Removes rows older than a retention window.
Delete Old Rows.code:
// Delete rows older than two years.
query(`DELETE FROM household_visits WHERE visit_date < current_date - INTERVAL 2 YEAR`);

Aggregate Indicators By District.description: Computes monthly counts per district, e.g. to push aggregate values to DHIS2.
Aggregate Indicators By District.code:
// Count visits per district for one month. Rows are returned on state.data.
query(`
  SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS visits, COUNT(DISTINCT household_id) AS households
  FROM household_visits
  WHERE visit_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND visit_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY district
  ORDER BY district
`);

Get Rows Changed Since Date.description: Selects rows added after a date so later steps can forward them to another system.
